title: Build finserv one-pager + case study draft (regulated workloads ABM)
creator: Soojin Lee
description:
Create customer-facing finserv one-pager (Private + Dedicated positioning for regulated workloads) and a companion anonymized case study draft usable for outbound + landing page CTA. Focus: auditability, data controls, predictable performance, and deployment flexibility (VPC/on-prem). Must be compliant with approved claims (no over-claiming SOC2/HIPAA/PCI, no “certified” language unless substantiated). Assets will be used in the 6–8 week ABM pilot for financial services targets.

Primary audiences:
- CISO / Security & Risk: evidence pack index, audit logging, encryption, SSO/SAML, retention/residency, incident response
- Platform/ML Engineering: reference architecture, performance economics, rollout/fallback, operational tooling
- Procurement: packaging guardrails (Dedicated vs Private), support tiers, contracting motion (DPA/SLA)

Target deliverables:
1) Finserv one-pager v1 (PDF + doc source)
2) Anonymized case study draft v0.5 (internal only initially; external-ready after approvals)
3) Proof points inventory + “approved claims” list for reuse in sequences/landing page
4) Compliance-safe wording checklist included at the end of the doc for future edits
acceptance_criteria:
One-pager meets the following:
- Includes 2 deployment patterns (Dedicated + Private) with guidance on when to use which
- Includes a simple reference architecture (text description is OK; design can be added in DES ticket)
- States security controls in “capability available” terms (no certifications implied)
- Contains explicit “what we do / what we don’t do” section for data handling
- Includes CTAs: (a) 30-min security review call, (b) 2-week benchmark + architecture validation pilot
- Reviewed and approved by Security (Naomi Feldman or Dr. Aisha Rahman delegate) and Legal/commercial check by Michael Grant or Sofia Mendes

Case study draft meets the following:
- Uses anonymized customer naming (e.g., “North American retail bank”) unless explicit permission is obtained
- Contains measurable outcomes with caveats (ranges or “observed in pilot”) and excludes customer-confidential metrics unless approved
- Includes a short implementation timeline and stakeholder map (buyer journey) that matches how deals are actually progressing in HubSpot/Fireflies notes

compliance_safe_wording_checklist:
Compliance-safe wording checklist (must pass before external sharing):
- Avoid: “HIPAA compliant,” “PCI certified,” “guaranteed,” “zero retention,” “fully air-gapped” unless explicitly true for the referenced deployment and contract.
- Prefer: “supports,” “available,” “can be configured,” “upon request,” “in scope per agreement.”
- SOC2: state “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA” (do not summarize findings; do not imply coverage beyond scope).
- Data handling: explicitly state what data is processed/stored (prompts/outputs/logs/metadata) and what is optional/configurable.
- Retention: if variable, state “configurable retention controls; default and minimum retention depend on deployment mode and logging configuration.”
- Residency: state “region pinning available (hosted/dedicated) and customer-managed networking (private)”; do not promise “all data stays in-country” without confirming subprocessor + support.
- Encryption/KMS: state “encryption in transit and at rest; KMS/HSM integrations available for Private deployments” and link to evidence pack for details.
- Audit logs: do not list fields unless confirmed current; reference “audit logging with export to customer systems (e.g., SIEM)” and provide schema link under NDA if required.
- Benchmarks: include conditions (model, context length, batch settings, hardware class) and label as “pilot results” not “guarantees.”
- Logos/names: no customer logo or identifiable name without written permission and Legal review.
- Final approvals required: Security (Naomi Feldman or delegate) + PMM (Soojin Lee) + Legal/commercial check (Michael Grant/Sofia Mendes) before publishing.
